protectedInterfaceOriginal: Entering Shapeshift clears the Refrain counter because the Druid changes the body sounding the Weave; beast-form casting remains limited by class features.
engine: Wisdom governs spells, form attacks and class DC/M. Hit Die d8; book armor, weapons, saves and skills remain. Retain your own ability scores, HP, saves, proficiency and personality in all forms; form traits replace only the stated anatomy, movement and attacks. No additional monster stat block or separate beast HP pool. One natural attack per Attack Action unless a form explicitly states otherwise, attack PB+WIS, printed dice+WIS damage. Missing natural attack is 1d6 bludgeoning; default walking Speed 30 ft, normal AC, Medium size. Hawk is Tiny, Bear/Earth Warden/hero forms may be Large when space permits. Equipment melds and cannot be used while melded; magical numeric bonuses persist only if compatible with form anatomy and never duplicate armor.

This class follows its explicit book progression instead of the ordinary 25-choice template. Base 1 grants Druidic, spellcasting, all five Base forms and 2 shifts/long rest. Choose one of seven Circles at 2; its level 2 features are a Base-stage exception. Enter the chosen Circle Arch path at 3, gain its 6 feature, then Circle Hero forms at 10 and its 14 feature. Arch Forms unlock 11 despite the historical word Arch; these are forms, not a second promotion. At 11 attune up to 2 Arch forms during long rest. Base forms remain available at higher levels. All features below are automatic at their gate for the chosen Circle; no generic extra class-card choices are added.

Preparation: two cantrips at 1, three at 4, four at 10, plus explicit Circle bonuses. Prepare class level+WIS modifier ranked Druid spells (minimum 1) each long rest, rank limited by Druid spell-rank access, not merely by enough RP. Use approved operational spell entries and Core V 2 RP table/costs in the shared configuration. Book rank-times-two cost and imported spell-slot terminology are preserved as superseded alternatives for this pilot. Circle always-prepared spells do not count toward preparation and use ordinary RP/Dissonance. Rituals must have ritual tag, be prepared and take printed casting time plus 10 minutes; waive base RP only, never consumed materials or other costs. ASI/feat milestones 4/8/12/16/19 belong to general advancement and must not be granted twice.

Shifting: Bonus Action, one long-rest shift use, 10 minutes, early reversion Bonus Action. Reaching 0 HP or incapacitation ends form; excess damage stays on your own HP. Shift uses follow detailed book table:2 at 1, 3 at 4, 4 at 7, 5 at 10, 6 at 13, 7 at 16, 8 at 19. Supplemental runtime alternative 2/3/4/5/6 at 1/4/8/12/16 remains preserved. At 20 changing form is unlimited but does not refill finite form benefits. Speech unavailable in Base forms, available in Arch/Hero. No spellcasting in form until Beast Spells 18 except an explicit form permission. Maintaining an existing spell concentration is allowed, still only one concentration. Changing form spends a use and ends old form features/summons; it does not reset once/rest abilities.

Transformation reserves prevent unlimited replacement HP: at long rest record Buffer Reserve=2 L+M and Form Surge Reserve=PB. A form giving temporary HP draws that many from Buffer Reserve, up to remaining amount, with normal nonstacking; never real healing. A form special described once/transformation also spends 1 Form Surge and cannot be refreshed by resuming the form. Form Surge refills only long rest. Forms cannot grant free casts, RP or shift uses. Auras affect at most 3 enemies and once per enemy per round; retaliation once/round total; ongoing riders refresh, never stack. Entering a legal Shapeshift clears the Refrain counter and remembered repeated-spell name, as the protected source contract requires. It does not reduce accumulated Dissonance. Natural attacks do not clear Refrain.

Circle of the Land chooses one terrain at 2. Always-prepared spell pairs at 3/5/7/9 are exactly the source table lines 2662–2669, reproduced in source appendix; their source names resolve to existing approved spell entries before use. They do not bypass rank gates. For this pilot Circle spells are permitted exceptions to ordinary list membership, not newly authored variants. Moon Circle Forms CR table is historical external-stat language: use only these bounded forms, not arbitrary CR beasts. Early Moon benefit is +S damage on first form hit each turn. No imported monster multiattack, spellcasting or legendary actions.

Circle summary: Land preserves lore and recovery; Moon improves shifting; Storm controls lightning and wind; Thorns works poison and roots; Winterfang works cold; Rotshaper uses bounded swarms; Ashen Grove works fire and regrowth. Land/Thorns duplicate Blight Elk and Tanglemaw names are kept as separate source identities. Source auto-failed hostile saves in Master of Decay/Ash become once/turn-2 on one save, not unavoidable control. Stronger supplemental flavor riders are represented explicitly below or retained as unadopted alternatives in source provenance.
workedExample: Druid 5 Moon, WIS 16 PB 3 S 2 M 3: RP 12, shifts 3, Buffer Reserve 13, Form Surges 3, HP 30/38. Prepare 8 ranked spells plus three cantrips.

Turn 1 Bonus Action Bear: shifts 3→2, draw 13 of requested 20 buffer, reserve 13→0, temp HP 13. Action claw attack PB+WIS=+6, damage 2d6+3+1 plus Moon first-hit 2. Shifting clears the Refrain counter and remembered repeated-spell name; accumulated Dissonance is unchanged.
Enemy deals 10 damage: temp HP 13→3, real HP 30 remains. No additional beast HP exists.
Turn 2 Moon healing Bonus Action spends 2 RP, RP 12→10, rolls 2d8=7, HP 30→37. It cannot repair the buffer reserve. Action claw as usual.
Turn 3 Bonus Action change Wolf spends another shift, shifts 2→1. Old Bear temporary HP ends. Wolf bite 1d8+3, target STR against DC 14 or Prone. No new buffer, RP or Form Surge generated.
At 10 this character gains Moon Hero forms; Arch forms still wait until 11. At 20 unlimited changes still cannot refill Buffer or Surge reserves.
balanceQuestions: Is the shared HP model with finite buffer durable enough?
Do level2 Circle exceptions remain clear beside the ordinary Arch3 rule?
Do powerful flight and form resistances require encounter adjustments?

cards.name: Druidic
cards.effect: Know Druidic. Other speakers notice and read your hidden Druidic messages. Nonspeakers notice their presence on WIS Perception DC 15 but need translation magic or learning the language to read them.

source.originalText:
Druidic
You know Druidic, the secret language of druids. You can speak the language and use it to leave hidden messages. You and others who know this language automatically spot such a message. Others spot the message's presence with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check but can't decipher it without magic.

cards.name: Spellcasting
cards.effect: Prepare and cast according to the engine. WIS attack/DC; rank gates, components, concentration, Dissonance and RP apply. This entry creates no extra actions or second resource pool.

source.originalText:
Spellcasting
Drawing on the essence of nature itself, you can cast spells to shape that essence to your will. See chapter 10 for the general rules of spellcasting and chapter 11 for the druid spell list.
Cantrips
At 1st level, you know two cantrips of your choice from the druid spell list. You learn additional druid cantrips of your choice at higher levels, as shown in the Cantrips Known column of the Druid table.
Preparing and Casting Spells
The Druid table shows how many Resonance Points you have to cast your druid spells. A spell's base RP cost is twice its Resonance Rank (Rank 0 cantrips cost 0), modified by explicit class features and current Dissonance. You regain expended RP according to the Resonance recovery rules.
You prepare the list of druid spells that are available for you to cast, choosing from the druid spell list. When you do so, choose a number of druid spells equal to your Wisdom modifier + your druid level (minimum of one spell). The spells must be of a level for which you have Resonance Points.
For example, if you are a 3rd-level druid, you have 7 Resonance Points. With a Wisdom of 16, your list of prepared spells can include six spells, and they can be of 1st or 2nd level in any combination. If you prepare the Rank 1 spell cure wounds, its base cost is 2 Resonance Points before explicit specialization or Dissonance modifiers. Casting the spell doesn't remove it from your list of prepared spells.
You can change your list of prepared spells when you finish a long rest. Preparing a new list of druid spells requires time spent in prayer and meditation: at least 1 minute per spell level for each spell on your list.
Spellcasting Ability
Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your druid spells, since your magic draws upon your devotion and attunement to nature. You use your Wisdom whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Wisdom modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a druid spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one.
Spell save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier
Spell attack modifier = your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier
Ritual Casting
You can cast a druid spell as a ritual if that spell has the ritual tag and you have the spell prepared.

Spellcasting Focus
You can use a druidic focus as a spellcasting focus for your druid spells.

cards.name: Shapeshifting
cards.effect: Assume an unlocked prepared form or revert early. Apply engine HP, equipment, concentration and reserve rules. This is not a spell and cannot copy monster stat blocks.

source.originalText:
Shapeshifting
At 1st level, you gain the ability to transform into various animal forms. Shapeshifting is Aethel's native druidic transformation discipline and functions according to the following rules:

Activation and Duration
You can use a bonus action to assume a beast form. You can remain in beast form for 10 minutes per use. You then revert to your normal form unless you expend another use of this feature. You can revert to your normal form earlier by using a bonus action on your turn.

Uses per Day
At 1st level, you can use your Shapeshifting ability twice per long rest. You gain additional uses as you reach higher levels, as shown in the Shapeshifting Uses column of the Druid table.

Available Forms
At 1st level, you can transform into any of the Base Druid Forms listed below. At 11th level, you gain access to Arch Druid Forms. At 10th level, you gain access to Hero Druid Forms specific to your chosen Circle.
Limitations While Transformed
While in beast form:
You cannot cast spells unless specified by your Hero Class
Your ability to speak is limited (only preserved in arch/hero forms)
You retain your mental ability scores (Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma)
You gain the physical traits of the chosen form as specified

cards.name: Wolf Form (Striker)
cards.effect: Speed 40 ft; advantage on hearing/smell Perception. Bite 1d8 piercing+WIS; target STR save against Druid DC or Prone, once/target/round. All damage remains your own HP.

source.originalText:
Wolf Form (Striker)
+10 ft. movement speed
Keen Senses: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell
Bite: 1d8 piercing damage + DC 11 Strength save or target is knocked prone

cards.name: Bear Form (Tank)
cards.cost: One shift; buffer drawn from reserve
cards.effect: Gain up to 20 temporary HP from reserve; AC max(normal, 14). Claw 2d6 slashing+WIS+1. Buffer disappears on reversion and cannot be refilled through free shifting.

source.originalText:
Bear Form (Tank)
+20 HP temporary buffer
AC set to 14 (unless your normal AC is higher)
Claw: 2d6 slashing damage
Rage-like trait: Deal +1 damage per attack

cards.name: Hawk Form (Scout)
cards.effect: Tiny, flight 60 ft, walking 10 ft, advantage on sight Perception. Talon 1d4 slashing+WIS; advantage if you descended at least 10 ft immediately before attack. No carrying Medium allies or casting spells before 18.

source.originalText:
Hawk Form (Scout)
Flight speed of 60 ft.
Keen Sight: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight
Dive Attack: 1d4 slashing damage + advantage if striking from above

cards.name: Boar Form (Brawler)
cards.effect: Resistance to slashing. Tusk 1d6 piercing+WIS. After moving 10 ft directly toward target, first hit/turn adds 1d6 and STR save or push 5 ft; no repeated charges from forced movement.

source.originalText:
Boar Form (Brawler)
Tough Hide: Resistance to slashing damage
Charge: If you move at least 10 ft. straight toward a target, you deal an additional 1d6 damage and push the target 5 ft.

cards.name: Panther Form (Stealth)
cards.effect: Speed 40 ft, darkvision 60 ft, +4 Stealth. Claw 2d4 slashing+WIS; after 20 ft straight approach hit, STR save or Grappled. Escape Action against Druid DC; ends on separation/reversion. Only one held target, no free Restrained.

source.originalText:
Panther Form (Stealth)
+4 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks
60 ft. darkvision
Pounce: If you move at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hit with a claw attack (2d4 damage), the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be grappled
Druid Circle

cards.name: Timeless Body
cards.effect: Age one year per ten elapsed years. Does not prevent damage, aging magic, hunger, disease or rest requirements, and grants no retroactive lifespan restoration.

source.originalText:
Timeless Body
Starting at 18th level, the primal magic that you wield causes you to age more slowly. For every 10 years that pass, your body ages only 1 year.

cards.name: Beast Spells
cards.effect: Perform verbal/somatic Druid spell components in any form. Still cannot supply material components from melded gear. At 20 Archdruid waives only noncostly unconsumed components.

source.originalText:
Beast Spells
Beginning at 18th level, you can cast many of your druid spells in any shape you assume using Shapeshifting. You can perform the somatic and verbal components of a druid spell while in a beast shape, but you aren't able to provide material components.

cards.name: Archdruid
cards.effect: Unlimited legal form changes. Buffer Reserve and Form Surges remain finite; per-rest powers, spell costs and uses never refresh on changing form. Ignore verbal/somatic and noncostly unconsumed material components for Druid spells, including in form.

source.originalText:
Archdruid
At 20th level, you can use your Shapeshifting feature an unlimited number of times.
Additionally, you can ignore the verbal and somatic components of your druid spells, as well as any material components that lack a cost and aren't consumed by a spell. You gain this benefit in both your normal shape and your beast shapes from Shapeshifting.

cards.name: Dire Wolf
cards.duration: Form 10 minutes; fear up to 3 rounds
cards.effect: Arch attunement required. Speed 40 ft, bite 2d6 piercing+WIS; advantage when active ally threatens target 5 ft. Howl Action up to 3 enemies WIS save or Frightened, repeat end each turn, maximum 3 rounds. No free bite with Howl.

source.originalText:
Dire Wolf
Pack Tactics: You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of your allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and not incapacitated
Bite: 2d6 piercing damage
Howl: As an action, you can emit a frightening howl. Each hostile creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

cards.name: Earth Warden (Dire Bear)
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; 10 ft radius up to 3 creatures
cards.effect: Arch attunement required. Gain up to 30 temp HP from reserve, nonmagical physical resistance. Slam DEX save 2d6 bludgeoning+WIS and Prone on failure, half damage no Prone success. Ordinary claw 1d8+WIS when Slam unavailable.

source.originalText:
Earth Warden (Dire Bear)
30 temporary hit points while in this form
Earth Slam: As an action, you can slam the ground, causing a shockwave in a 10-ft. radius. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.
Stone Resistance: You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

cards.name: Sky Serpent
cards.effect: Arch attunement required. Flight 80 ft with hover, +2 DEX saves. Bite 2d8 lightning+WIS. Once/shift may spend 1 Form Surge to add 1d4 against wet target; no repeated electrical propagation.

source.originalText:
Sky Serpent
Flight speed of 80 ft.
Lightning Bite: Your bite deals 2d8 lightning damage
Glide Reflexes: You gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity saving throws

cards.name: Ironhorn Ram
cards.effect: Arch attunement required. AC max(normal, 17), immune Prone. Ram 1d8+WIS bludgeoning; after 20 ft straight approach first hit/turn adds 3d6, STR against Druid DC or push 10 ft. No bonus against same target more than once/round.

source.originalText:
Ironhorn Ram
AC set to 17 (unless your normal AC is higher)
Charge: If you move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hit with a ram attack, the target takes an extra 3d6 bludgeoning damage and must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 ft. away
Stability: You cannot be knocked prone

cards.name: Shadow Lynx
cards.effect: Arch attunement required. Claw 2d4+WIS magical slashing; +2 Stealth while motionless. When attack would hit, Reaction teleport 30 ft to visible empty space, causing triggering attack to miss if you leave its reach/range. Next claw before end next turn advantage. No blanket immunity to magical damage.

source.originalText:
Shadow Lynx
Blink: As a reaction when you would be hit by an attack, you can teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space you can see
Magical Attacks: Your attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks
Druid Circles
Circle of the Land

cards.name: Bonus Cantrip
cards.effect: Learn one additional Druid cantrip. Choose one terrain package for Circle Spells at 3/5/7/9; preserve exact source spell pairs and ordinary rank gates.

source.originalText:
Bonus Cantrip
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice.

cards.name: Natural Recovery
cards.effect: Restore ceil(Druid level/2)RP, capped by maximum. This is a finite added recovery, not spell slots or multiplied by rank. RP remains fungible; preserved source rank 6 spending restriction is not used in this simplified draft.

source.originalText:
Natural Recovery
Starting at 2nd level, you can regain some of your magical energy by sitting in meditation and communing with nature. During a short rest, you choose expended Resonance Points to recover. The Resonance Points can have a combined level that is equal to or less than half your druid level (rounded up), and none of the points can be used to cast spells of 6th level or higher. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.
For example, when you are a 4th-level druid, you can recover up to 2 Resonance Points during a short rest.
Circle Spells
Your mystical connection to the land infuses you with the ability to cast certain spells. At 3rd, 5th, 7th, and 9th level you gain access to circle spells connected to the land where you became a druid. Choose that land, arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, or Murk, and consult the associated list of spells.
Once you gain access to a circle spell, you always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you gain access to a spell that doesn't appear on the druid spell list, the spell is nonetheless a druid spell for you.

cards.name: Land's Stride
cards.effect: Ignore nonmagical difficult terrain and ordinary plant thorns. Advantage on saves against magically created/manipulated plants impeding movement. Does not bypass walls, fire or nonplant restraint.

source.originalText:
Land's Stride
Starting at 6th level, moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. You can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.
In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement, such as those created by the entangle spell.

cards.name: Nature's Ward
cards.effect: Immune to Charmed/Frightened from fey/elementals, poison damage, Poisoned and disease. Does not suppress all creature abilities or remove an existing curse.

source.originalText:
Nature's Ward
When you reach 10th level, you can't be charmed or frightened by elementals or fey, and you are immune to poison and disease.

cards.name: Blight Elk
cards.effect: Antlers 2d8+WIS piercing. Enemy starting within 5 ft CON save or 1d4 poison. Wither unattended mundane vegetation within 5 ft cosmetically; tainted water is visibly foul and harmless after 10 minutes. No mass contamination or permanent resource fabrication.

source.originalText:
Blight Elk
Aura of Decay: Enemies that start their turn within 5 ft. of you take 1d4 poison damage
Antlers: Your antler attack deals 2d8 piercing damage
Toxic Presence: Plants wither in your presence, and water becomes tainted

cards.name: Tanglemaw
cards.rangeAndTarget: Land Hero; bite 5 ft; sense 30 ft
cards.effect: Bite 2d6+WIS piercing, STR save or Restrained until end next turn, escape Action against DC. Thorny Body deals 1d4 piercing to one melee attacker after hit; no reflections. Sense ground-contact locations 30 ft on same connected surface, not identities through stone walls.

source.originalText:
Tanglemaw
Bite: Your bite attack deals 2d6 piercing damage and causes the target to be restrained on a failed DC 14 Strength saving throw
Thorny Body: Creatures that touch you or hit you with a melee attack take 1d4 piercing damage
Root Network: You can sense the presence of creatures touching the ground within 30 ft. of you

cards.name: Nature's Sanctuary
cards.effect: Before roll target WIS save; failure chooses another legal target or attack misses. Success immune to this feature 24 hours. Creature knows requirement; area effects and indirect hazards unaffected.

source.originalText:
Nature's Sanctuary
When you reach 14th level, creatures of the natural world sense your connection to nature and become hesitant to attack you. When a beast or plant creature attacks you, that creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your druid spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature must choose a different target, or the attack automatically misses. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this effect for 24 hours.
The creature is aware of this effect before it makes its attack against you.

cards.name: Combat Shapeshifting
cards.effect: Restore 1d8 real HP per RP paid, never beyond maximum. Does not restore temporary buffer or shift uses. No Dissonance as class technique; cannot heal after form ended/incapacitated.

source.originalText:
Combat Shapeshifting
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you gain Combat Shapeshifting. While transformed by Shapeshifting, you can use a bonus action to expend one or more Resonance Points, regaining 1d8 hit points for each RP expended. Activating Shapeshifting itself still spends a Shapeshifting use, not RP.

cards.name: Circle Forms
cards.effect: Add S damage to first natural-form hit each turn. Bounded replacement for importing higher-CR monsters; all form gates and attunement remain.

source.originalText:
Circle Forms
Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Shapeshifting to transform into more powerful beast forms than a typical druid. Your level as a druid determines the maximum CR of the form you can take, as shown in the Druid table.

cards.name: Primal Strike
cards.effect: Form attacks count as magical against defenses to nonmagical physical attacks. Does not ignore immunity to their actual damage type.

source.originalText:
Primal Strike
Starting at 6th level, your attacks in beast form count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

cards.name: Beastlord (Alpha Animal Hybrid)
cards.effect: Bite 2d6+WIS piercing; first hit/turn adds 1d4 of one chosen fire/cold/lightning, not all three. Up to 2 beast allies 30 ft gain+1 first attack/turn. Howl Action up to 3 enemies WIS save or Frightened until end next turn.

source.originalText:
Beastlord (Alpha Animal Hybrid)
Chimera Cub: Your attacks deal 1d4 each of fire, cold, and lightning damage in addition to their normal damage
Alpha Dire Wolf: You can intimidate all creatures within 15 ft. As an action, each creature in range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute
Pack Leader: Beast allies within 30 ft. of you gain advantage on attack rolls

cards.name: Mooncursed
cards.effect: Resistance to nonmagical physical damage except silver; other types unchanged. Bite 2d6+WIS piercing, +1d8 once/turn under real full moon. Howl Action choose up to 3 allies gain 2d8 temp HP total roll, or 3 enemies WIS save or Frightened through end next turn. Temp HP draws from Buffer Reserve per recipient.

source.originalText:
Mooncursed
Lycanthropic Resilience: You have resistance to all damage except silver
Lunar Rage: During a full moon, your attacks deal an additional 1d8 damage
Howl of the Wild: As an action, you can emit a howl that inspires allies or terrifies enemies. Choose one effect: allies within 30 ft. gain 2d8 temporary hit points, or enemies within 30 ft. must make a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.

cards.name: Elemental Shapeshifting
cards.cost: One shift and one elemental use
cards.effect: Choose bounded elemental form: AC 16, natural attack 2d8+WIS chosen element, one/Action. Air flight 60 lightning resistance; Earth burrow 20 through loose soil physical DR 2; Fire fire resistance and melee attacker 1d4 fire once/round; Water swim 60 water breathing cold resistance. Retain own HP/abilities, no external stat blocks.

source.originalText:
Elemental Shapeshifting
At 14th level, you gain the ability to transform into an elemental. You can transform into an air elemental, an earth elemental, a fire elemental, or a water elemental. You can use this feature twice. You regain expended uses when you finish a long rest.

cards.name: Storm Magic
cards.effect: Adjust ordinary rain/wind one mild degree; cannot create storms, combat damage, extinguish magical fire or cancel powerful weather spells. Learn thunderwave and fog cloud always prepared, normal costs/rank gates.

source.originalText:
Storm Magic
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you gain the ability to subtly control the weather around you. If it is raining, you can make it rain harder or stop. If it is windy, you can increase or decrease the wind's intensity. These minor changes last for 1 hour after you stop actively maintaining them.
Additionally, you learn the thunderwave and fog cloud spells, which don't count against your number of druid spells known.

cards.name: Thunderous Strike
cards.rangeAndTarget: Storm Circle; target Large or smaller damaged by lightning/thunder
cards.effect: Target STR save or push 10 ft directly away. No chain through reflected damage, secondary arcs or forced movement; requires your direct spell/form hit.

source.originalText:
Thunderous Strike
At 2nd level, when you deal lightning or thunder damage to a Large or smaller creature, you can push it up to 10 feet away from you.

cards.name: Storm's Embrace
cards.effect: Resistance lightning/thunder. Add WIS modifier to one damage roll against one target of your lightning/thunder spell, once/cast; no multiplication over pulses or area targets.

source.originalText:
Storm's Embrace
Starting at 6th level, you gain resistance to lightning and thunder damage. Additionally, whenever you cast a spell that deals lightning or thunder damage, add your Wisdom modifier to the damage it deals.

cards.name: Tempest Raptor
cards.effect: Flight 60 ft, advantage on saves against wind/lightning while airborne. Claw 2d6+WIS lightning; wet target adds 1d4 once/shift for 1 Form Surge. After melee hit on you, attacker takes 1d6 lightning once/round; no repeated disarm chains.

source.originalText:
Tempest Raptor
Lightning Claw: Your claw attacks deal 2d6 lightning damage
Flight: You have a flying speed of 60 ft.
Storm Shroud: You are surrounded by crackling electricity. Creatures that touch you or hit you with a melee attack take 1d6 lightning damage.

cards.name: Thunderhorn Stag
cards.rangeAndTarget: Storm Hero; antlers 5 ft; teleport 30 ft
cards.effect: Antlers 1d8+WIS piercing; after 20 ft approach first hit/turn also 2d8 thunder and CON save or Deafened through end next turn. Step Action teleport 30 ft, departure 10 ft radius up to 3 creatures CON save 2d8 thunder, half success. Sense natural storm approach 24 hours, no exact prediction of magical weather.

source.originalText:
Thunderhorn Stag
Charge: If you move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hit with a horn attack, the target takes 2d8 thunder damage and must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be deafened until the end of its next turn
Thunder Step: Once per transformation, you can teleport up to 30 ft. in a crack of thunder. Each creature within 10 ft. of the space you left must make a Constitution saving throw or take 2d8 thunder damage and be deafened until the end of its next turn.
Weather Sense: You can sense approaching storms up to 24 hours in advance

cards.name: Eye of the Storm
cards.effect: Moderate ordinary weather inside sphere, no concentration; does not neutralize spell damage or magical hazards. For lightning/thunder spells choose up to M creatures to succeed initial save and take 0 if normally half; later independent pulses unchanged.

source.originalText:
Eye of the Storm
At 14th level, you gain the ability to create a zone of relative calm within a storm. As an action, you can create a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on you. Within the sphere, winds are reduced to gentle breezes, precipitation stops, and temperature becomes moderate. This effect lasts for 10 minutes and doesn't require concentration.
Additionally, when you cast a spell that deals lightning or thunder damage, you can choose a number of creatures equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one) to automatically succeed on their saving throws against the spell, taking no damage if they would normally take half damage on a successful save.

cards.name: Toxic Affinity
cards.effect: Resistance poison and advantage saves against Poisoned. Learn poison spray cantrip in addition to normal limit; use operational catalog effect/cost.

source.originalText:
Toxic Affinity
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you gain resistance to poison damage and advantage on saving throws against being poisoned. Additionally, you learn the poison spray cantrip if you don't already know it.

cards.name: Blighted Touch
cards.duration: Instant; Poisoned through end next turn
cards.effect: CON save:2d6 poison and Poisoned on failure, half damage/no Poisoned success. Poisoned gives disadvantage attacks/ability checks unless general condition glossary supersedes. Requires normal reach, not automatic touch through barriers.

source.originalText:
Blighted Touch
Starting at 2nd level, you can channel decay through your touch. As an action, you can touch a creature and force it to make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature takes 2d6 poison damage and is poisoned until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and isn't poisoned.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

cards.name: Withering Aura
cards.effect: Up to 3 enemies starting turn in aura CON save or 1d6 poison, once/enemy/round. Mundane plants may wither; no damage to distant terrain or permanent poison stock. Ends on incapacitation.

source.originalText:
Withering Aura
Beginning at 6th level, you emanate an aura of decay. As a bonus action, you can activate this aura, causing nonmagical plants within 10 feet of you to wither and die. Additionally, each creature of your choice that starts its turn within 10 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d6 poison damage.
This aura lasts for 1 minute or until you dismiss it as a bonus action. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

cards.name: Blight Elk
cards.effect: Antlers 2d8+WIS piercing, +1d4 poison once/turn against Poisoned. Enemies starting 5 ft CON save or 1d4 poison. Ground 10 ft around you is difficult terrain for enemies, no lasting thorns after movement/reversion.

source.originalText:
Blight Elk
Aura of Decay: Enemies that start their turn within 5 ft. of you take 1d4 poison damage
Antlers: Your antler attack deals 2d8 piercing damage
Toxic Presence: Plants wither in your presence, and water becomes tainted

cards.name: Tanglemaw
cards.rangeAndTarget: Thorns Hero; bite 5 ft; sense 30 ft
cards.effect: Bite 2d6+WIS piercing, STR save or Restrained through end next turn, Action escape DC. One melee attacker/round takes 1d4 piercing; one creature restrained by your bite takes 1d4 at start turn. Ground sense 30 ft same surface and advantage against Prone; no wall-penetrating identification.

source.originalText:
Tanglemaw
Bite: Your bite attack deals 2d6 piercing damage and causes the target to be restrained on a failed DC 14 Strength saving throw
Thorny Body: Creatures that touch you or hit you with a melee attack take 1d4 piercing damage
Root Network: You can sense the presence of creatures touching the ground within 30 ft. of you

cards.name: Master of Decay
cards.effect: Immune poison damage/Poisoned. Before one target rolls initial save against your poison spell impose-2. Replaces source automatic failures; cannot combine multiple identical penalty applications or negate immunity.

source.originalText:
Master of Decay
At 14th level, you gain immunity to poison damage and the poisoned condition. Additionally, when you cast a spell that deals poison damage, you can choose a number of creatures equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one) to automatically fail their saving throws against the spell.

cards.name: Frost Magic
cards.effect: Learn ray of frost cantrip and ice knife always prepared, additional to normal counts, ordinary rank gates and costs.

source.originalText:
Frost Magic
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you learn the ray of frost cantrip if you don't already know it. Additionally, you learn the ice knife spell, which doesn't count against your number of druid spells known.

cards.name: Cold Resistance
cards.effect: Resistance cold and advantage on nonmagical extreme-cold exposure saves. No immunity to suffocation, ice entrapment or magical environmental damage.

source.originalText:
Cold Resistance
Starting at 2nd level, you gain resistance to cold damage. Additionally, you are naturally adapted to cold climates, as described in the environmental rules in Chapter 5.

cards.name: Winter's Embrace
cards.effect: Up to 3 enemies starting turn inside CON save or 1d6 cold and Speed-10 ft through end turn. Once/enemy/round; success no effect. Does not stack multiple slows or affect flying targets outside sphere.

source.originalText:
Winter's Embrace
Beginning at 6th level, you can surround yourself with an aura of biting cold. As a bonus action, you can activate this aura, causing each creature of your choice that starts its turn within 10 feet of you to make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d6 cold damage and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
This aura lasts for 1 minute or until you dismiss it as a bonus action. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

cards.name: Snow Leopard
cards.effect: Claw 2d6+WIS cold, +1d4 once/turn against slowed foe. +5 Stealth on ice/snow and advantage on legal Hide there; source+10 reduced provisionally. Ignore ordinary ice/snow movement penalties, not magical restraining ice.

source.originalText:
Snow Leopard
Claw: Your claw attacks deal 2d6 cold damage
Stealth: You gain a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks made in snowy or icy terrain
Frost Walk: You can move across icy surfaces without making ability checks and through snow without penalty

cards.name: Frost Wyrmling
cards.cost: One shift; breath one short-rest use
cards.rangeAndTarget: Winterfang Hero; 30 ft cone up to 3 creatures
cards.effect: AC normal+2, cold immunity. Claw 1d8+WIS cold. Breath 4d6 cold DEX half. One breath target may have cold resistance ignored once/shift for 1 Form Surge; immunity remains. No general physical resistance from cold terrain in this draft.

source.originalText:
Frost Wyrmling
Breath Weapon: As an action, you can exhale a 30-foot cone of freezing air. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 4d6 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Once you use this breath weapon, you can't use it again until you complete a short or long rest.
Scales of Ice: You gain a +2 bonus to AC
Cold Immunity: You are immune to cold damage

cards.name: Master of Winter
cards.effect: Cold immunity. Bounded winter weather invocation: create ordinary snow/sleet, difficult ground and sight limited 60 ft; no immediate damage or building collapse. This replaces undefined free high-rank control weather until an operational catalog version is selected; no RP, still 1 D.

source.originalText:
Master of Winter
At 14th level, you gain immunity to cold damage. Additionally, you can cast the control weather spell once without expending Resonance Points, but when you do so, you can only create weather conditions related to winter (such as snow, sleet, or freezing rain). Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

cards.name: Vermin Affinity
cards.rangeAndTarget: Rotshaper Circle; Tiny natural beasts within 10 ft
cards.effect: Communicate simple feelings/directions; normally indifferent, not compelled allies. Cannot extract facts beyond their senses or control swarms for extra actions.

source.originalText:
Vermin Affinity
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you can communicate simple ideas with tiny beasts such as rats, spiders, insects, and other vermin. Additionally, such creatures are indifferent to you by default rather than hostile.

cards.name: Swarm Summoning
cards.effect: Summon one swarm using shared companion profile: AC 12+floor(PB/2), HP 2 L, Speed 30, melee attack PB+WIS for S d6 piercing. Bonus Action command, one damaging action across all pets. Tiny-body movement through 1 inchgaps; no separate attacks per insect.

source.originalText:
Swarm Summoning
Starting at 2nd level, you can summon a swarm of tiny creatures to aid you. As an action, you can summon a swarm of insects, rats, or spiders (your choice) in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you. The swarm acts on your initiative count and obeys your verbal commands. It lasts for 10 minutes, until it drops to 0 hit points, or until you dismiss it as a bonus action.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

cards.name: Plague Bearer
cards.rangeAndTarget: Rotshaper Circle; creature hit by your melee attack
cards.effect: CON save or Poisoned and 1d6 poison at start turn. Repeat end turn; ends on success or after 3 turns. No lasting epidemic or loss of character control.

source.originalText:
Plague Bearer
Beginning at 6th level, you can infect creatures with debilitating diseases. When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can force it to make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature is poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the creature takes 1d6 poison damage at the start of each of its turns.
The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

cards.name: Carrion Rat King
cards.effect: Bite 1d8+WIS piercing+2d6 poison; CON save or Poisoned through end next turn. Immune disease/Poisoned, not poison damage. Summon Action creates one bounded engine swarm 1 minute, same command budget; replaces previous form swarm.

source.originalText:
Carrion Rat King
Poison Bite: Your bite attack deals 1d8 piercing damage plus 2d6 poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute.
Summon Swarm: As an action, you can summon a swarm of rats that acts on your initiative and obeys your mental commands. The swarm lasts for 1 minute or until reduced to 0 hit points.
Disease Immunity: You are immune to disease and the poisoned condition.

cards.name: Insect Broodmother
cards.rangeAndTarget: Rotshaper Hero; up to 2 swarms adjacent
cards.effect: AC normal+3, climb 30 walls/ceilings, bite 1d8+WIS piercing. On entry optional spend surge spawn 2 bounded shared profile swarms, both end with form, combined one commanded attack/turn. Once/shift for another Form Surge turn one crit against you into normal hit; no infinite insects.

source.originalText:
Insect Broodmother
Spawn Swarms: Each time you transform into this form, you can spawn 1d4 swarms of insects (CR 1/4 each) that act on your initiative and obey your mental commands. The swarms last until they are reduced to 0 hit points or until you revert to your normal form.
Chitinous Armor: You gain a +3 bonus to AC
Wall Crawling: You can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without making an ability check.

cards.name: Master of Vermin
cards.effect: Swarm form: own HP/AC, physical resistance, Speed 30, fit Tinygaps, natural attack S d6+WIS piercing. No flight unless choosing bats (flight 30), which forfeits physical resistance. Replacing a summoning spell's beast with swarm uses same single companion budget and paid spell, never multiplied dice/creatures.

source.originalText:
Master of Vermin
At 14th level, you gain the ability to transform into a swarm of tiny beasts (insects, rats, bats, or spiders) as if using your Shapeshifting feature. While in swarm form, you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and you can move through any space large enough for a Tiny creature without squeezing.
Additionally, when you cast a spell that summons or creates beasts, you can choose to summon a swarm instead of individual creatures.

cards.name: Fire Affinity
cards.effect: Resistance fire and additional produce flame cantrip. No immunity to smoke/suffocation or supernatural heat beyond resistance.

source.originalText:
Fire Affinity
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you gain resistance to fire damage. Additionally, you learn the produce flame cantrip if you don't already know it.

cards.name: Blazing Rebirth
cards.rangeAndTarget: Ashen Grove; ally/self 30 ft taking fire damage
cards.effect: Grant L+M temporary HP after real hostile/environmental fire damage. Cannot reduce triggering hit retroactively or trigger from deliberate ally/self-farming. Normal temporary HP nonstacking; no buffer reserve payment because finite feature use.

source.originalText:
Blazing Rebirth
Starting at 2nd level, you can channel the regenerative power of fire. When you or an ally within 30 feet of you takes fire damage, you can use your reaction to grant temporary hit points equal to your druid level + your Wisdom modifier to that creature.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

cards.name: Flame Stride
cards.rangeAndTarget: Ashen Grove; up to 6 ground tiles traversed
cards.effect: For 3 rounds immune to nonmagical environmental fire only. Leave up to 6 total 5 ft fire tiles along movement; creatures entering/starting DEX save or 1d6 fire, once/creature/round across all tiles. Tiles end with feature; no recursive area expansion.

source.originalText:
Flame Stride
Beginning at 6th level, you can move through fire without taking damage. Additionally, when you move through a space containing fire, you can choose to leave a trail of fire behind you. Each creature that enters this fire for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 1d6 fire damage.
The fire lasts for 1 minute or until extinguished. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

cards.name: Charbear
cards.rangeAndTarget: Ashen Hero; claw 5 ft/aura 5 ft/smoke 10 ft
cards.effect: Claw 2d8+WIS fire; first hit/turn Burn 1d4 next turn. Up to 3 enemies starting 5 ft CON save or 1d6 fire. Smoke Action opaque 10 ft radius sphere centered fixed point you occupy, concentration 3 rounds; all vision blocked, no poison in this draft. Wind 20 mph disperses.

source.originalText:
Charbear
Flame Aura: Creatures within 5 ft. of you take 1d6 fire damage at the start of their turn
Fire Claw: Your claw attacks deal 2d8 fire damage
Smoke Cloud: As an action, you can create a 20-foot-radius sphere of smoke centered on yourself. The area is heavily obscured, and creatures other than you that start their turn in the smoke must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of their next turn.

cards.name: Blazewood Stag
cards.cost: One shift; blast one long-rest use
cards.effect: Antlers 1d8+WIS piercing; 20 ft charge adds 2d6 fire once/turn. Leave up to 3 fire tiles/turn, last until start next turn, DEX save or 1d8 fire once/creature/round. Blast Action 6d6 fire DEX half up to 3 creatures 10 ft, not free on reversion.

source.originalText:
Blazewood Stag
Flaming Trail: You leave a trail of fire behind you as you move. Each creature that enters this fire for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 1d8 fire damage.
Burning Charge: If you move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hit with a horn attack, the target takes an additional 2d6 fire damage.
Conflagration: Once per long rest, you can explode in a burst of flame. Each creature within 10 ft. of you must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 6d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

cards.name: Master of Ash
cards.cost: Plant growth normal cost and 10 minutes
cards.effect: Immune fire. Before one initial save against your fire spell impose-2, never auto failure. A paid prepared plant growth may restore ordinary vegetation in burned land within its printed area; no instant food/valuable timber, magical plants or creature creation.

source.originalText:
Master of Ash
At 14th level, you gain immunity to fire damage. Additionally, when you cast a spell that deals fire damage, you can choose a number of creatures equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one) to automatically fail their saving throws against the spell.
Furthermore, you can cast the plant growth spell to instantly restore vegetation to an area devastated by fire, causing plants to grow to full maturity within minutes rather than over the course of a year.

exceptionSchedule.1: Druidic, spellcasting, five Base forms; 2 shifts/long rest
exceptionSchedule.2: Choose ONE Circle; only its level-2 benefits
exceptionSchedule.3: Enter the chosen Circle Arch; Land gains terrain spells
exceptionSchedule.10: Chosen Circle Hero forms; 5 shifts; fourth cantrip; Land Nature’s Ward
exceptionSchedule.11: Attune any TWO of five Arch forms at each long rest
exceptionSchedule.20: Archdruid: unlimited shifting; finite reserves remain
